exposure: Obstetric Comorbidity Index (OCI) scores (representing risk for severe maternal morbidity - SMM)
cohort: The study included live births to Medicaid recipients across 44 US states from 2016 to 2020.
finding: Medicaid recipients with high OCI scores were only slightly more likely to use postpartum contraception than their low-risk peers, and over half did not attend an outpatient postpartum visit by 60 days.
